description: Compare two visual states structurally (dHash, CLIP vector, JSON diff, layout delta) or two video trajectories (keyframe similarity, divergence point). Provide state_a_id/state_b_id for state comparison, or video_a_id/video_b_id for video trajectory comparison.

state_a_id.description: ID of visual state A (state comparison mode)

state_b_id.description: ID of visual state B (state comparison mode)
